title: stellaria longipes var. altocaulis
intro: Stellaria longipes var. altocaulis, commonly known as Alpine chickweed, is a plant species in the carnation family. This plant has been used in herbal medicine for its health benefits, including its anti-inflammatory properties, which can help soothe skin irritations and reduce swelling. The therapeutic actions of Alpine chickweed include its ability to act as an antioxidant, antimicrobial, and antiseptic, making it effective in treating wounds, burns, and other skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Alpine chickweed include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
